source: https://www.threads.com/ measured in the owner-authorized authenticated Orca Browser tab
auth_state: authenticated for feed/search/post/insights/compose/reply; logged-out for logged-out fixture
replacements: usernames, post text, post IDs, media alt text and profile data replaced with synthetic content; roles, nesting, control labels and URL patterns preserved
limits: one account, one host, one day; external replies, captcha, submit acknowledgement and session portability were not measured
